name: Display: Samsung DECON composer + ION buffer allocator
description: Replaces Huawei's Kirin display HALs with a composer that presents the client target through the Samsung DECON window-config ioctl on /dev/graphics/fb0 (the S9+ kernel has no DRM/KMS), and a dma-buf allocator on Samsung ION. Without it the panel is switched off when composer_host closes fb0. Build the two libraries with build/build_ohos.sh. It also sets persist.sys.graphic.GpuApitype to 0 (OpenGL): the OTA default 1 (Vulkan) makes render_service call a null Vulkan function pointer at its first frame (the Huawei Vulkan ICD cannot create a device on a Mali-G72) and crash-loop.
